full_judgment: 32. We are sorry to say that we are disappointed at the conduct of the case before us right from drafting of the plaint up to leading of the evidence. How a simple suit for recovery of bank dues even when the claim to be realized by sale of any property could be registered as a title suit. How the bank can come up with a declaration that certain property was mortgaged. How it can evade the presumption that at the date of institution of the suit the bank was not sure that the property was really mortgaged. Is it the reason for which the plaint was framed as a title suit? How prayers for interlocutory order for appointment of receiver, temporary injunction etc could be included in the relief sought for in the plaint is also beyond our comprehension. In the schedule to the Code of Civil Procedure pro-forma of all standard plaints are given. How we could expect from a lawyer that he is sure to obtain a decree for the bank without producing the papers sanctioning loan and/or advance and duly certified statements of accounts as required by law.
